table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	purinvcode=prledger.purinvcode ,
	prinvcode =prledger.prinvcode ,
	suppcode =prledger.suppcode ,
	custcode=prledger.custcode,
	datacarrycustcode=prledger.datacarrycustcode,
	salesmancode =prledger.salesmancode ,
	date =prledger.date ,
	discperc =prledger.discperc ,
	flatdisc =prledger.flatdisc ,
	misccharges=prledger.misccharges ,
	salestax =prledger.salestax ,
	posted =prledger.posted ,
	postdate =prledger.postdate ,
	remarks =prledger.remarks ,
	invtotal=prledger.invtotal,
	prcatcode =prledger.prcatcode ,
	address1 =supplier.address1 ,
	city =supplier.city ,
	phone =supplier.phone ,
	username=users.username,
	originaldate=prledger.originaldate,
	modifiedby=prledger.modifiedby,
	postedby=prledger.postedby,
	invgstperc1=prledger.invgstperc1,
	headerno=prledger.headerno,
	headerinvno=prledger.headerinvno,
	gcode=0,
	AccountFor=prledger.AccountFor,
	PaymentMode=prledger.PaymentMode,
	PaymentAccCode=prledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Amt=prledger.Amt,
	AmtBy=prledger.AmtBy,
	AmtDate=prledger.AmtDate,
	AmtReference=prledger.AmtReference,
	Outstandingamt=prledger.Outstandingamt,
	marked=prledger.marked,
	prtypecode=prledger.prtypecode,
	Terms1=prledger.Terms1,
	Terms2=prledger.Terms2,
	Terms3=prledger.Terms3,
	Terms4=prledger.Terms4,
	Terms5=prledger.Terms5,
	icatcode=prledger.icatcode,
	PurchaseInvNo=prledger.PurchaseInvNo,
	UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate=prledger.UpdateAvgPriceWithNetRate
FROM
	crs_prledger prledger ,
	supplier ,
	users ,
	accounts     

WHERE
	( prledger.clientinstanceid = :ar_clientinstanceid) AND
	( prledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode ) and
	( prledger.salesmancode = users.usercode ) and 
	( prledger.suppcode = accounts.acccode ) and
	( prledger.prinvcode = :ar_prinvcode )
